gold_facts.text: The degree of kinship is determined by the number of births that link the two persons.
Two persons are related in the direct line if one descends from the other.
Two persons are related in the collateral line if they descend from a common third person and are not related to each other in the direct line.

competing_candidates: The rule on relationship by marriage (in-laws) is a neighbouring definition but does not answer blood relationship.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Der Grad der Verwandtschaft bestimmt sich nach der Zahl der sie vermittelnden Geburten.' Direct/collateral line in Abs 2 in all langs. 210:21 (in-laws) does not compete. de 37, fine.

question: How does Swiss law work out how closely two family members are related? For example, why is my grandmother related to me in a different way than my cousin is?

gold_facts.text: Deleting or modifying an entry in the land register requires a written declaration by the persons entitled under that entry.
This declaration can be given by signing the daybook (journal) of the land register.

competing_candidates: Rules on simplified deletion of entries that have obviously lost their legal significance, and on judicial deletion of an easement that has lost its usefulness, could also bear on removal; the question states the right is still used.
provenance.critic_notes: 'Zur Löschung oder Abänderung eines Eintrages bedarf es einer schriftlichen Erklärung' (de); journal signature in Abs 2 all langs. Deletion-for-uselessness rules (210:736, 976) excluded because the question says the right is still used. fr 1791.

question: J'ai un droit de passage inscrit sur le terrain de mon voisin et je l'utilise toujours. Il veut le faire rayer ou modifier au registre foncier. Peut-il le faire sans moi, ou faut-il mon accord, et sous quelle forme ?

gold_facts.text: A right of pre-emption may be exercised when the property is sold and on any other transaction that is economically equivalent to a sale.
Allocation to an heir in the division of an estate, a forced auction and acquisition for the performance of a public task are, in particular, not pre-emption cases.

competing_candidates: The Civil Code rules on statutory pre-emption rights of co-owners and building-right holders; the question concerns a contractual right.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'Nicht als Vorkaufsfall gelten namentlich die Zuweisung an einen Erben in der Erbteilung'. Contractual pre-emption is stated, so ZGB 681/682 (statutory rights) do not compete. Paraphrase 'Aufteilung des Nachlasses' avoids the article term; DE rank 5 acceptable.

question: Ich habe mit meinem Nachbarn vertraglich vereinbart, dass ich sein Grundstück als Erster kaufen darf, wenn er es verkauft. Jetzt ist er gestorben, und das Grundstück soll bei der Aufteilung des Nachlasses an seinen Sohn gehen. Kann ich mein Recht in diesem Fall ausüben, und wann überhaupt?

gold_facts.text: The surety is liable in all cases only up to the maximum amount stated in the surety deed.
The surety is liable for a contractual penalty only if this was expressly agreed.
The surety is liable for the costs of enforcing against the principal debtor only if he was given the opportunity in time to avoid them by paying the creditor.

provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 'tenue qu'à concurrence du montant total indiqué dans l'acte'; 'n'encourt une peine conventionnelle que s'il en a expressément été convenu'; costs only if 'mise, en temps utile, à même de les prévenir'. FR rank 3; 'frais des poursuites' is shared but is ordinary French. 220:493 (form, max amount) is related, not equal.

question: Je me suis porté garant pour le prêt de mon frère, avec un montant maximum de 50 000 francs inscrit dans l'acte. La banque me réclame maintenant, en plus de la dette, une pénalité prévue dans le contrat de prêt et les frais des poursuites qu'elle a engagées contre mon frère. Dois-je tout payer?

gold_facts.text: A person threatened with damage from another person's building or structure can demand that the owner take the measures needed to avert the danger.

competing_candidates: Civil Code neighbour-law rules on protection against threatened damage from a landowner overstepping his property rights (weaker fit: the person threatened is a passer-by, not a neighbour)
Code of Obligations rule on the owner's liability for damage caused by a defective building (applies after damage occurs)
provenance.critic_notes: Police-order fact removed; no damage yet, asker not a neighbour, so 210:679 and 220:58 do not compete. de: 'kann von dem Eigentümer verlangen, dass er die erforderlichen Massregeln'.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on reserved police orders removed. Situation set before any damage, and the asker is not a neighbouring landowner.

question: There is an old, privately owned stone wall along the public footpath my children take to school, and parts of it are crumbling and look like they could fall onto the path. Nothing has happened yet. Can I require the owner to make it safe before someone gets hurt?

gold_facts.text: If a company controls one or more undertakings, their acquisition of its shares is subject by analogy to the conditions, limits and consequences that apply to the company acquiring its own shares.
The controlling company must create a separate statutory retained earnings reserve equal to the acquisition value of those shares.
A legal entity controls another undertaking if it directly or indirectly has the right to appoint or remove the majority of the members of its supreme management or administrative body.

competing_candidates: The article on a company acquiring its own shares (the ten percent limit and conditions) is the rule applied by analogy; it does not cover group subsidiaries.
provenance.critic_notes: Balance-sheet clause now points to 659b cpv 2 'riserva legale da utili a sé stante', not 963 cpv 1. 963 cpv 2 n 2 needed for control. 659a cpv 4 (negative item) only by analogy; 659b specific. it 3 acceptable for hard xref.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: last clause narrowed to the balance-sheet entry, so the consolidated-accounts duty no longer answers it. B facts reduced to the control test the question states; the majority-of-votes and dominant-influence tests are ruled out or not asked.

question: Una filiale della nostra società anonima ha comprato azioni della società madre. La madre non ha la maggioranza dei voti nella filiale, ma ha il diritto di nominare e revocare la maggioranza del suo consiglio d'amministrazione. Basta questo perché valgano le regole sull'acquisto di azioni proprie, e che cosa deve iscrivere la madre nel proprio bilancio per queste azioni?

gold_facts.text: The declaration exercising conversion or option rights must refer to the provision of the articles on conditional capital and, if the law requires a prospectus, also to the prospectus.
Cash contributions must be deposited with a bank at the exclusive disposal of the company.
Shareholder rights arise when the contribution obligation is fulfilled.

competing_candidates: The conditional capital article stating that the share capital increases when rights are exercised and contributions paid (used in slot s-0044) is close on the timing point.
The general rule on depositing cash contributions at a bank at incorporation or ordinary capital increase.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (it): 'rinvia alla disposizione statutaria sul capitale condizionale'; 'depositati presso una banca'; 'I diritti dell'azionista nascono non appena sia stato adempiuto l'obbligo'. IT rank 12. The question follows the three paragraphs in order and leans toward a checklist, but it is answerable and specific to 653e.

question: Sono dipendente di una società anonima e voglio usare il mio diritto di ottenere nuove azioni. A cosa deve fare riferimento la mia dichiarazione, dove devo versare i soldi e da quando posso esercitare i diritti di un azionista?

gold_facts.text: At least seven members must take part in founding a cooperative.
If the number falls below this, the company law provisions on deficiencies in the organisation of the company apply by analogy.

provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'müssen mindestens sieben Mitglieder beteiligt sein'; 'Vorschriften des Aktienrechts über Mängel in der Organisation ... entsprechend anwendbar'. DE rank 12. No twin with a member minimum elsewhere.

question: Wir sind fünf Leute aus dem Dorf und möchten zusammen eine Genossenschaft für einen Dorfladen gründen. Sind wir genug, und was passiert, wenn die Genossenschaft später weniger Mitglieder hat als nötig?

gold_facts.text: If a general partnership has only two partners, the partner who did not cause the dissolution may, under the same conditions, continue the business by paying the other partner his share of the partnership assets.
The court may order this where dissolution is sought for good cause relating mainly to the person of one of the partners.

competing_candidates: The preceding article on excluding a partner and continuing the business when there are more than two partners; it sets the 'same conditions' referred to in A.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (fr): 'celui qui n'a pas donné lieu à la dissolution peut ... continuer les affaires'; 'Le tribunal peut en disposer ainsi'. FR control, rank 5; 'dissoute/associé' are unavoidable terms. No twin article for two-partner partnerships (KG applies the same rules by reference).

question: Nous ne sommes que deux associés dans une société en nom collectif, et c'est à cause de mon associé que la société doit être dissoute. Puis-je garder l'entreprise et continuer seul, que dois-je lui remettre, et le juge peut-il l'ordonner?

gold_facts.text: A mandate is a contract by which the agent undertakes, as agreed, to manage the business entrusted to him or to perform the promised services.
The rules on mandates apply to work not governed by the statutory provisions on other types of contract.
The agent is entitled to remuneration if this is agreed or customary.

competing_candidates: The brokerage contract rules (fee for finding a buyer) and the commission contract (selling in one's own name); the situation has her concluding the sales in the owner's name, which fits neither.
provenance.critic_notes: Brokerage ruled out: signing in owner's name fits mandate, not 412 or commission (own name). fr: 'Une rémunération est due au mandataire si la convention ou l'usage'. EN; ranks high.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: 'finding buyers' replaced with concluding the sales in the owner's name to rule out brokerage.

question: I asked an acquaintance to sell my late mother's car and furniture for me: she was to sign the sales contracts in my name, collect the money and handle the paperwork. We never talked about money. Now that it's done she has sent me a bill. Do I have to pay her, and what kind of contract is this in the first place?

gold_facts.text: In a company whose shares are not listed, the depositary representative must ask the depositor for voting instructions before each general meeting.
If the depositor's instructions are not given in time, the depositary votes in accordance with the depositor's general instructions.
If there are no general instructions either, the depositary abstains from voting.

competing_candidates: The stock-company rules on representation at the general meeting of listed companies (independent proxy), which do not apply because the company is not listed.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (it): 'chiede al deponente istruzioni per il voto, prima di ogni assemblea'; 'in difetto di queste, si astiene dal voto'. IT control, rank 8. Separate from 689b cpv. 3 (independent/organ proxy abstains at once) because the bank is a depositary.

question: Ho alcune azioni di una piccola società anonima che non è quotata in borsa. I titoli sono custoditi dalla mia banca, che vota al posto mio alle assemblee. Quest'anno non sono riuscito a dire alla banca come votare prima dell'assemblea. Cosa deve fare la banca in questo caso?

gold_facts.text: A landlord's notice can be challenged if given within three years after the end of a conciliation or court proceeding about the lease in which the landlord largely lost.
This protection does not apply where notice is given following the sale of the leased property under the rule allowing the new owner to terminate.
When the landlord sells the property after the lease was concluded, the lease passes to the buyer together with ownership.

For residential or commercial premises, the new owner may terminate for the next legal date, observing the legal notice period, if he claims an urgent personal need for himself or his close relatives.

competing_candidates: The rules on extension of the lease, which may still give the tenant more time even where the notice cannot be challenged; the question asks only about the post-dispute protection and the new owner's right to terminate.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (en facts vs fr/de): 271a al. 1 let. e 'dans les trois ans ... a succombé dans une large mesure'; al. 3 let. d 'en cas d'aliénation de la chose louée (art. 261, al. 2)'; 261 al. 2 let. a urgent need. Cross-ref is genuine. Note that the exception for urgent own need (al. 3 let. a) also applies; the facts do not contradict it.

question: Last year I won a dispute with my landlord about a rent reduction before the conciliation authority, and I was told that this protects me from being thrown out for a while. Now the building has been sold and the new owner has given me notice on my flat, saying his daughter urgently needs it to live in. Does my protection still help me, and is the new owner even allowed to end my lease?

gold_facts.text: Unless there is a contrary note, the endorser of a bill of exchange is liable for acceptance and payment.
The endorser may prohibit further endorsement of the bill.
If he does so, he is not liable to the persons to whom the bill is subsequently endorsed.

competing_candidates: The corresponding cheque-law rule on the endorser's liability; the question is about a bill of exchange.
The bill-of-exchange rule making all signatories jointly liable to the holder, which presupposes the endorser's liability.
provenance.critic_notes: Supported (de): 'haftet mangels eines entgegenstehenden Vermerks für die Annahme und die Zahlung'; 'in diesem Falle haftet er denen nicht'. DE control, rank 25. No cheque twin (no acceptance for cheques; search for 'weiter indossiert' finds only 1005).

question: Ich habe einen Wechsel, den ich von einem Geschäftspartner bekommen hatte, mit meiner Unterschrift auf der Rückseite an einen Lieferanten weitergegeben. Muss ich dem Lieferanten geradestehen, wenn der Wechsel nicht angenommen oder nicht bezahlt wird? Und kann ich verhindern, dass ich auch gegenüber Leuten hafte, an die der Lieferant ihn später weitergibt?

gold_facts.text: The auditor must be independent, and its independence must not be impaired either in fact or in appearance.
A direct shareholding in the company's share capital is incompatible with independence.
Employees of the auditor who are not involved in the audit may not be members of the board of directors of the audited company.

competing_candidates: The stock-company rule on the independence of the auditor in a limited audit, which states the general independence requirement but not this list of incompatibilities; the question now fixes an ordinary audit.
provenance.critic_notes: Ordinary audit stated, so 220:729 excluded. fr: 'une participation directe ... au capital-actions'; employee rule in al. 3. fr 11. Twins 818/906 excluded by SA.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: ordinary audit stated.

question: Le réviseur qui contrôle les comptes de notre société anonyme possède directement une petite partie de nos actions. Notre SA est soumise au contrôle ordinaire. En plus, une employée de son bureau, qui ne travaille pas du tout sur notre dossier, siège dans notre conseil d'administration. Est-ce que cela remet en cause son impartialité aux yeux de la loi?

gold_facts.text: A credit intermediary is any natural or legal person who professionally brokers consumer credit contracts.

A crowdlending intermediary is any natural or legal person who professionally organises, for individual consumers, a coordinated granting of consumer credit in which several lenders not acting professionally can take part.

competing_candidates: The definitions of the lender and of the consumer credit contract are neighbouring definitions in the same act.
provenance.critic_notes: Title term and 'par métier' paraphrase removed. fr 4(2): 'organise pour un consommateur un octroi coordonné de crédits'. FR rank 2 now driven by the act name, acceptable.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: removed the article's title term and the close paraphrase of the non-professional lender wording.

question: Une plateforme en ligne organise pour moi un prêt pour acheter une moto, financé ensemble par plusieurs particuliers qui prêtent leur argent à titre privé. Quel statut la loi sur le crédit à la consommation donne-t-elle à cette plateforme, et en quoi se distingue-t-elle d'une entreprise qui se contente de me trouver un crédit auprès d'un prêteur ?

gold_facts.text: If the risk decreases significantly, the policyholder may terminate the contract in writing or text form with four weeks' notice or demand a reduction of the premium.

If the insurer refuses to reduce the premium or the policyholder does not accept the proposed reduction, the policyholder may terminate within four weeks of receiving the insurer's notice, with four weeks' notice.
The premium reduction takes effect as soon as the policyholder's notice reaches the insurer.

provenance.critic_notes: 28a al.1-3 supports all facts (de: 'eine Prämienreduktion zu verlangen'). 28 is risk increase. DE rank 586.

question: Als ich meine Hausratversicherung abschloss, hatte meine Wohnung keinerlei Einbruchschutz. Inzwischen habe ich eine Alarmanlage und eine Sicherheitstür, das Einbruchsrisiko ist also viel kleiner. Was kann ich von der Versicherung verlangen, und was, wenn sie die Prämie nicht senken will?

gold_facts.text: A private person who intentionally fails to comply with a decision of the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner or of the appeal authorities, served with a warning of this penalty, is liable to a fine of up to CHF 250,000.

competing_candidates: Other criminal provisions of the data protection act carry the same maximum fine for different conduct.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «È punito con la multa fino a 250 000 franchi il privato che intenzionalmente non ottempera». Closest: 235.1:60-62 (same maximum, other conduct), 235.1:64 (offences in a business; sole-trader framing keeps 63 primary). No lexical signal.
provenance.writer_note: Sole trader chosen to keep the question on a natural person rather than a business undertaking.

question: Ich führe als Einzelunternehmer einen Onlineshop. Der Datenschutzbeauftragte des Bundes hat mir etwas angeordnet und dabei ausdrücklich mit Strafe gedroht, falls ich mich nicht daran halte. Was riskiere ich, wenn ich die Anordnung absichtlich ignoriere?

gold_facts.text: The federal authorities responsible for enforcing the Unfair Competition Act may cooperate with competent foreign authorities and international organisations or bodies, and in particular coordinate investigations.
This cooperation requires that it is necessary to combat unfair business practices and that the foreign authorities or bodies are bound by official secrecy or an equivalent duty of confidentiality.

provenance.critic_notes: Treaty fact removed. de 21(1): 'zusammenarbeiten und insbesondere Erhebungen koordinieren, sofern'. DE rank 1 via 'Bundesbehörden/zusammenarbeiten', same-language control, tolerable. Closest 241:22.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: removed the fact on Federal Council treaties.

question: Ich bin auf eine Abofalle einer Firma aus dem Ausland hereingefallen, und offenbar betrifft das viele Leute in mehreren Ländern. Dürfen die Bundesbehörden, die in der Schweiz gegen solche Geschäftsmethoden vorgehen, mit den Behörden der anderen Länder zusammenarbeiten und gemeinsam ermitteln, und unter welchen Voraussetzungen?

gold_facts.text: The court may hold instruction hearings at any time.
An instruction hearing serves to discuss the matter in dispute informally, supplement the facts, attempt to reach an agreement between the parties and prepare the main hearing.
The court may take evidence at the instruction hearing.

competing_candidates: Civil Procedure Code provisions on the main hearing and on the hearing in simplified proceedings.
provenance.critic_notes: it: «L’udienza istruttoria serve a esporre liberamente l’oggetto litigioso»; 226(3) evidence. Closest: 272:228 (main hearing), 272:246 (simplified procedure, excluded by «ordinary»). No lexical signal.

question: My contract dispute is being handled in ordinary civil proceedings. Before the main hearing, the judge has invited both sides to a meeting. What is such a meeting meant for, and can the judge already hear witnesses or take other evidence there?

gold_facts.text: The court asks the witness to state his or her identity.
The court asks the witness to describe personal relationships with the parties and other circumstances that may affect the credibility of the testimony.
The court asks the witness to state the facts of the case that he or she observed.

competing_candidates: Civil Procedure Code article on the form of witness examination (warning to tell the truth and about penalties), which does not list what the witness is asked
provenance.critic_notes: fr: «de décrire ses relations personnelles avec les parties». Facts map to lit. a-c in de/fr/it. Closest: 272:171 (form of examination). de rank 504.

question: Ich bin als Zeugin in einem Zivilprozess zwischen meinem Nachbarn und seinem Vermieter vorgeladen. Worüber wird mich das Gericht befragen, und muss ich zum Beispiel auch offenlegen, dass ich mit einer der Parteien befreundet bin?

gold_facts.text: From the opening of bankruptcy, claims under a continuing contract can be asserted as bankruptcy claims only up to the next possible termination date or the end of the fixed term.
The creditor must credit any benefits obtained during that period.
To the extent the bankruptcy estate has used the services, the counterclaims arising after the opening of bankruptcy are debts of the estate.

competing_candidates: The preceding bankruptcy article on the conversion of claims and the estate's right to perform bilateral contracts.
Contract-specific bankruptcy rules in the Code of Obligations (for example for leases); the question uses a service contract to avoid them.
provenance.critic_notes: FR al.1: 'au plus tard jusqu'au terme le plus proche de résiliation'; al.2 'valent dettes de la masse'. All facts supported de/fr/it. 281.1:211 (bilateral contracts) is related but not equal. FR rank 10, no copying of 'contrat de durée'. Natural.

question: J'ai un contrat de maintenance informatique de cinq ans avec une entreprise cliente, résiliable seulement à la fin de chaque année. Cette entreprise vient d'être déclarée en faillite. Pour quelle période puis-je faire valoir mes mensualités dans la faillite, et qu'en est-il si l'office des faillites continue à utiliser mes services après la faillite ?

gold_facts.text: If the debtor intends to seek a composition during the extraordinary moratorium, the draft composition with the documents and the commissioner's opinion must be submitted before the moratorium ends.
Within six months after the moratorium expires, neither a composition moratorium nor a new extraordinary moratorium can be granted.

competing_candidates: The general composition procedure rules on applying for a composition moratorium, which do not contain the six-month bar after an extraordinary moratorium.
provenance.critic_notes: FR al.1 'projet de concordat ... doit être présenté avant la fin du sursis'; al.2 six-month bar. Supported de/fr/it. IT rank 2 driven by 'moratoria/sospensione', standard terms, no copied phrasing. 281.1:337 only sets conditions of the moratorium.

question: A causa di una grave crisi economica generale, al mio negozio è stata concessa una sospensione straordinaria dei pagamenti verso i creditori. Vorrei approfittarne per proporre ai creditori un accordo per pagare solo una parte dei debiti: entro quando devo presentare la proposta? E se la sospensione finisce senza che io abbia fatto nulla, posso chiederne subito un'altra o passare a una moratoria per l'accordo?

provenance.critic_notes: 281.1:93 al.1 'déduction faite de ce que le préposé estime indispensable' is closest; 221.214.1:28 refers to cantonal minimum-subsistence guidelines. No amounts. Not answerable; pointer 281.1:93 reasonable.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy Act article on income that can be seized only in part.

question: My wages are being garnished. What exact monthly base amount must the debt collection office leave me as a single person, and how much is added for each child?
trap_reason: The Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy Act leaves the protected minimum to the official's discretion; the base amounts come from guidelines of the debt enforcement supervisory authorities.

provenance.critic_notes: 272:98 al.1 'Vorschuss von höchstens der Hälfte der mutmasslichen Gerichtskosten' and 272:96 (cantonal tariffs) are closest. They give a fraction, not an amount for a 30,000 claim. Not answerable; pointers 272:96/98 reasonable.

question: Wie viel Gerichtskosten muss ich im Kanton Zürich ungefähr vorschiessen, wenn ich meinen früheren Geschäftspartner auf 30'000 Franken verklage?
trap_reason: The Civil Procedure Code leaves court fee tariffs to the cantons, so the amount depends on the cantonal fee ordinance, not on any of the eight acts.

provenance.critic_notes: VVG mentions only supplementary insurance to social health insurance (221.229.1:35a al.4, 47a, 100). Nothing on admission to basic insurance or premiums. Not answerable; pointer 221.229.1:35a weak.
provenance.writer_note: Likely wrong retrieval: Insurance Contract Act articles on supplementary health insurance and on disclosure of risks.

question: Ma caisse-maladie peut-elle refuser de m'accepter dans l'assurance de base parce que j'ai déjà un diabète, et a-t-elle le droit de me faire payer une prime plus élevée pour cette raison ?
trap_reason: Compulsory basic health insurance is governed by the Health Insurance Act, which falls outside the Insurance Contract Act and the other 7 acts.
